messages:
ana: Quick pulse — we need to deconflict vendor timelines and cert windows for H200 (B200 too), MI300, Gaudi. Can we get owners and concrete week ranges for compatibility testing + marketplace listing embargo? Prefer to lock by EOD Monday. Thanks.

raj: I can own MI300 validation. Need confirmation of driver build and golden image from infra team.

matt: Marketplace PM here — we have a 2-week review window before publish. If certs land in week X we can schedule listing in week X+2. Need embargo window for joint announcement.

beth: Partner ops — rough ETA: H200 perf validation starts wk of 2026-05-04, B200 follow-ups wk of 2026-05-18. We'll confirm exact dates by Friday. Embargo preference: 48-72h pre-announce heads up. :calendar:

ken: Runtime/infra note — for MI300 we need CUDA/ROCm driver matrix and kernel version pinned. If anyone's running perf tests, please include `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi -q` outputs. Also CI image tag: redwood/ci:mi300-20260501.

sophie: SI certification question — how long are you expecting integration test runs? We budget 3 business days per release for our SI partners. If we overlap multiple vendors, that doubles resources.

raj: +1 on logs. I'll add a tiny test harness. snippet:
```
# run quick perf
./run_perf.sh --model=gpt-medium --tokens=1024 --backend=mi300
```

matt: @calendar-bot can we tentatively block: 2026-05-03 -> 2026-05-21 for combined cert sprints (placeholder)

calendar-bot: Event created: 'vendor-interop-cert-sprint' 2026-05-03T10:00 -> 2026-05-21T17:00. Invitees: @ana @raj @matt @sophie @beth @ken

beth: Also, SI partners want a compatibility matrix doc. Creating a shared doc: https://docs.redwood.com/partners/interop/compat-matrix (will populate drivers + test cases)

ana: Perfect — I'll make an owner table in that doc. Owners: @raj MI300, @beth H200/B200, @sophie SI integration, @ken runtime. I'll follow up with a short checklist. :thumbsup:

matt: Thanks — I'll reserve marketplace review slots.

sophie: One more — can we standardize the test artifact naming? prefer `redwood-<vendor>-<model>-YYYYMMDD.tgz` so SI teams can script pulls.

ana: Agreed. I'll add to doc. Meeting if needed Thurs. Closing loop.
